title: The Golden Hair And The Cerussa
subtitle: A strand of hair, a handful of lead powder, and a bag of Sharpodonty.

items.text: The Golden Hair And The Cerussa

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: This can't be happening! The festival was supposed to be a secret...

items.speaker: Soldier
items.text: It's true! Our reports say that the cavalry will be here soon!

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: Could someone have betrayed us to the Duke?

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Gah! That pathetic Comaetho is always taking the wind from our sails.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: W-what do we do now?!

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: That must be the Duke's cavalry... Oh, no!

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: It's time to run... Mr. Fool, we have to get out of here!
Taking a deep breath, Jeffrey regained his composure.

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: Quick, inform the Mayor, and have him stall the cavalry.

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: Let's proceed as planned, wrap up the festival early. Performers, use the secret passages we've prepared for your escape.

items.speaker: Soldier
items.text: Yes, sir!

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: As I said, Troupe Master Charlie, you'd best leave now.

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: I'm truly sorry about this... None of us wanted to put your troupe at risk!

items.speaker: Jeffrey
items.text: But if these knights catch wind of you, nothing good will come of it.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: I-I understand.

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Mr. Fool, we've got to get everyone out now!

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Or else they'll be right on our tails!

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Too true, Troupe Master!

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: And if they chase us down, they'll strangle us, and hoist our bodies on flagpoles.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: "At that time, the crows will feast upon our flesh, like a most profane ritual."

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Alas! Alack! A terrifying outcome. We must make our exit as soon as possible.
With the performance's scheduled debut closing in, the rest of the troupe were busy with final preparations.

items.speaker: Troupe Member I
items.text: Troupe Master? Mr. Fool? Why are you back so soon?

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Everyone...
Clueless about what was to unfold, their fellow performers were still basking in the festive atmosphere, slow to react.

items.speaker: Troupe Member II
items.text: Come to check on us? Everything's set for the show!

items.speaker: Troupe Member I
items.text: All that was left was waiting for you, hahaha!
Costumes were unpacked and prepared, and makeup already painted on their faces.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Oh my, what a cheerful sight.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: Of course, our actors should be excited about hitting the stage.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: It's a shame they haven't realized yet that fate has come as a muddy palm, to smear them their careful preparations!

items.speaker: Charlie
items.text: Everyone, I have an announcement...
But her soft voice was quickly drowned out by the excited chatter.

items.speaker: Troupe Member I
items.text: I'm telling you, this script will blow the audience away!

items.speaker: Troupe Member II
items.text: Too bad the stage setup's pretty basic this time...

items.speaker: Troupe Member I
items.text: Hey, don't be picky. In these times, just getting to perform is a blessing! We've got to make do with what we have!

items.speaker: Troupe Member II
items.text: I'm not being picky! It's only that I was up all night, imagining our performance!

items.speaker: Troupe Member I
items.text: I can tell! Your powder is barely covering up those dark circles—let me apply more; we can't have the audience notice.

items.speaker: Everyone
items.text: Hahaha!
The bursts of powder rising in the air as new makeup was applied caused a shimmering in the candlelight; Charlie had to swallow back what she was about to say.

items.speaker: The Fool
items.text: So much hesitation, Troupe Master Charlie? Is that stage fright?
A peculiar smile slipped through his mask.
It carried a hint of mockery and sarcasm—emotions "The Fool" had rarely laid on her.
TO BE CONTINUED ...
